scope: Eight curated astronomical simulation recordings from the user-provided archive. Materials MD, related materials CG, unrelated footage and publication supplements from other collections are excluded.
selection_method: 87 video files, 55 byte-distinct recordings after SHA-256 deduplication. Astronomy candidates were inspected at multiple times. Selected files receive complete decode checks during conversion.
editing: Full original frame and timing; no spatial crop, upscaling, AI restoration, frame interpolation, color remapping or added scientific labels. H.264/yuv420p MP4 for browser compatibility; PNG posters from the source.
provenance_limit: Embedded author/year/process captions are evidence about the recording, not a verified match to a paper figure or a recovered numerical setup. This gallery is archival footage, not a new reproduction or a numerical validation.

clips.title: Thermal instability in 3D
clips.description: A nearly uniform rendering develops into separated structures. The original title identifies thermal instability with conduction and viscosity.
clips.caption_evidence: Embedded caption: Thermal Instability + conduction + viscosity; Koyama & Inutsuka 2002.
clips.quality: Good for compact gallery display. Grain-like texture and limited rendering detail are already visible in the source.

clips.title: A shock sweeps up warm gas
clips.description: A corrugated layer develops behind the advancing shock. The original caption gives a shock speed of 14.4 km/s.
clips.caption_evidence: Embedded caption: WNM Swept-Up by 14.4km/s Shock (3D); Koyama & Inutsuka 2002.
clips.quality: Good for compact display; small structures soften when enlarged. Source presentation is only 5 fps.

clips.title: A magnetized shock in 3D
clips.description: A shock-compressed structure evolves in the MHD-labelled recording. Compare the visible evolution with the hydrodynamic-labelled clip; these are not yet established as a controlled matched pair.
clips.caption_evidence: Embedded caption: WNM Swept-Up by MHD Shock (3D); Koyama & Inutsuka 2002.
clips.quality: Good at native or smaller size. Fine structures are soft in the recording; native cadence is 5 fps.

clips.title: Thermal instability with MHD
clips.description: The initially filled box develops connected structures as the viewpoint rotates.
clips.caption_evidence: Embedded caption: Thermal Instability + MHD; Koyama & Inutsuka 2002.
clips.quality: Useful as a historical rotating view. Only 3 fps; expect visibly stepped motion, not smooth modern animation.

clips.title: A developing layer and its close-up
clips.description: The wide view and close-up show an increasingly structured interface. Both original panels and color bars are retained.
clips.caption_evidence: Descriptive title based on visible panels; original file demo1.avi.
clips.quality: One of the stronger 2D presentation sources: 800 x 600 at 10 fps. Small labels still require native-size viewing.

clips.title: Two-phase gas and its pressure-density track
clips.description: Spatial structure is displayed alongside the pressure-density plane and equilibrium curve. Original time annotations, arrows and axes are retained.
clips.caption_evidence: Descriptive title based on visible panels; original file 1024CC.avi. The filename is not treated as a verified mesh size.
clips.quality: Useful for explaining the spatial/phase-plane connection. At 680 x 340, fine annotations are too small for a large-screen hero.

clips.title: An MHD-labelled layer
clips.description: The recording follows the evolution of a thin layer, with overlaid lines and arrows.
clips.caption_evidence: Original file mhd_layer.avi and visible log-density scale; numerical run inputs are not recovered.
clips.quality: Useful for a layer-focused exhibit. The bottom axis caption is partly clipped in the original frame; this has not been reconstructed.

clips.title: Growing and merging structures
clips.description: Small initial variations develop into separated, evolving structures. Use this clip for qualitative morphology.
clips.caption_evidence: Descriptive title based on visible evolution; original file phase.avi.
clips.quality: Qualitative use only: the lower axis caption is clipped and the recording does not provide a complete visible color scale.
